text: The restorative bank. Six lamps in a village, twelve in Tideglass,
and thirty-one here, in three tiers, all of them lit.
There is a second bank behind the wall. It is also full.
Recovery tanks for Kin too badly hurt for a lamp.
Two are occupied and screened off. A card on each screen says
QUIET PLEASE, and somebody has drawn a very small flower under it.
A brass terminal, twinned with every other in Caelora. THE ROOST.
Kin you cannot carry wait here. The city one holds eleven thousand.
Somebody has polished the handle until the maker's name has gone.
The board of waiting times, chalked and rubbed out all day.
TRAINERS: NO WAIT. WORKING KIN: NO WAIT. FOUND AND HURT: NO WAIT.
It has said NO WAIT for eleven years. It is a matter of some local pride.
A collection tin for the night service, which runs from ten until six
and costs nothing, like everything else in here.
The tin is full. It is emptied twice a day.
Shelves of case notes, one row per district, twenty-two districts.
Aureline is not one city. It is twenty-two of them
that have grown into each other and agreed to share a river.
A wall of thank-you letters, four deep and going up out of reach.
The oldest is from the year the clinic opened.
Nobody has ever taken one down.
Chairs for waiting, and a jug of water, and a basket of blankets
with a card on it reading TAKE ONE, KEEP IT.
The basket is refilled every morning and empty by every evening.
A rack of leaflets on caring for a Kin that has been frightened.
It is the thickest leaflet on the rack and the one that runs out.
The first line is: IT IS NOT ANGRY WITH YOU.
